# xAI

> > xAI developer documentation for Grok AI models, APIs, and SDKs

xAI provides AI models including Grok with capabilities for text generation, reasoning, and audio synthesis. Developers can integrate xAI models using the xAI API, Python SDK, JavaScript SDK, and OpenAI-compatible interfaces.

## Key Topics

- Grok models
- xAI API
- xAI SDK
- Python SDK
- JavaScript SDK
- Text to Speech API
- grok-4.20-beta-latest-non-reasoning
- API key generation
- xAI Console
- OpenAI SDK compatibility
- Audio generation
- Voice synthesis
- Swift integration
- @ai-sdk/xai

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started | xAI](https://docs.x.ai/developers/quickstart): Quickstart tutorial for using Grok models via xAI API and SDK

## Audio & Speech

- [Text to Speech | xAI](https://docs.x.ai/developers/model-capabilities/audio/text-to-speech): xAI Text to Speech API guide for converting text to audio (MP3, μ-law)
